summary: Backend: 16/16 new-feature pytest tests pass covering upload+auth+download content-type, message attachments (file_url) + empty rejection, reactions toggle on channel + DM messages + 404 on invalid message, typing indicator (POST→GET excludes self, cleared on message send), voice join/participants/leave + 403 for non-member, voice signal store + consume on GET, and invite flow re-verify (valid + invalid 404). Frontend (Playwright, alice@test.com): server create works; CreateChannelModal supports channel-type-text/voice toggle and creates voice channel 'voz-ui' visible under 'CANAIS DE VOZ'; VoiceRoom renders voice-title and voice-join-button ('Entrar na chamada'); 'Copiar link de convite' (copy-invite-link-button) visible in sidebar; message sent via Enter key renders with react-button-<id>; emoji popover opens, clicking 👍 adds reaction chip reaction-👍 with count 1; clicking chip toggles reaction off (0 chips); paperclip (attach-image-button → file-input) uploads via /api/upload and sends the message — image renders inside messages-container; typing-indicator element present.

issues: React-emoji quick popover buttons lack data-testid for individual emojis in the quick-select (only applied chips carry reaction-<emoji>). Minor — tests can still click them via index.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') (FastAPI recommends lifespan).

GET /api/files/{path} does not require auth — any uploaded object is reachable by URL guessing (uuid-based path makes it practically safe but technically publicly listable if path is known). Consider signed URLs or auth-gated download.
voice_signals and typing collections have no TTL/index; stale rows accumulate (voice filtered by 12s cutoff but documents remain in Mongo). Add TTL index.
react_message loops over channel then DM collections sequentially — fine, but a message_id prefix (msg_/dm_) would allow a direct lookup.
Upload size cap (15MB) only after full read — consider streaming/aborting earlier for very large uploads.
test_credentials: alice@test.com / pass1234 (and bob@test.com / pass1234). Signup creates TEST_ prefixed users during pytest runs.
seed_data_creation: pytest creates fresh TEST_ users + a TEST_NFServer with a 'voz' voice channel per module run. UI run created a 'UITestServer2' server with 'voz-ui' voice channel under alice@test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend new-features suite at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py uses pytest-xdist loadscope; original suite at /app/backend/tests/test_linkchat_backend.py still passes. Frontend: use Enter key to send messages (clicking send-message-button directly with page.click force=True can race with the form submit — Enter is more reliable). The react button is only visible on message hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100) but clicking directly via its data-testid=react-button-<id> works with force=True. Quick-select emoji buttons in the popover don't have data-testids — use CSS selector 'div.absolute.right-0.top-8 button'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all 4 new feature groups (invite, voice, uploads, typing+reactions) work end-to-end.
